notes: Historical NWC construction: NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − current portion of long-term debt, when disclosed). This is a pipeline-friendly approximation; it may differ from an alternative working-capital definition that includes/excludes items like deferred revenue. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Base-case forecast drivers (margins, D&A%, capex%, NWC%) are normalized assumptions derived from FY2025 levels and FY2026 capex commentary; they are not explicitly disclosed for each line item. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Peer multiples: EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA are taken from a Raymond James sector comp table that shows CY’25E multiples (proxy for NTM). P/E NTM was not provided in the source and is set to null. ([chartwellip.com](https://www.chartwellip.com/-/media/rj/dotcom/files/corporations-and-institutions/investment-banking/industry-insight/raymond_james_industrial_tech_newsletter.pdf))
WACC is an estimation (not directly disclosed in the provided primary sources); terminal growth is set conservatively at 0.02 for an economically stable terminal regime.

NOL utilization percent is not explicitly disclosed in a way that can be cleanly mapped to a DCF utilization rate, so it is set to null. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

catalysts: Q2 FY2026 execution versus the guided revenue and EPS range, and any update to FY2026 demand/tariff commentary. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))

Sustained order momentum (Q1 orders of $1.645B) that supports revenue conversion into FY26–FY28. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))

Resolution of policy/tariff uncertainty (IEEPA-related) that could impact near-term revenue timing. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))
company_overview: Global innovator in design, simulation, emulation, and test solutions, supporting product development from concept through commercialization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Two reportable segments: Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))
FY2025 revenue was $5.375B with income from operations (EBIT proxy) of $0.876B. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))
current_context: Q1 FY2026: revenue $1.60B (vs $1.30B in Q1 FY2025); orders $1.645B. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))

Q2 FY2026 outlook: revenue expected $1.690B to $1.710B (midpoint implies ~30% YoY growth); non-GAAP EPS expected $2.27 to $2.33. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))
Weighted diluted share count for Q2 outlook: ~173 million shares. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth normalizes in the mid-to-high single digits as secular demand persists across communications, aerospace/defense, semiconductors, and industrial electronics. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))

EBIT margin base-case targets gradual improvement toward ~17% as operating leverage stabilizes after acquisition/integration costs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Capex intensity held near ~3% of sales, consistent with FY2025 capex and company commentary expecting ~$160M capex in FY2026. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Working capital utilization is normalized in the forecast (material year-to-year variability historically). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))
key_risks: Tariffs/export control and geopolitical risk can directly affect demand, customer ordering cadence, and margins. ([s22.q4cdn.com](https://s22.q4cdn.com/444849635/files/doc_earnings/2026/q1/earnings-result/Q1-26-Earnings-Results.pdf))

Post-acquisition integration, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, and restructuring actions can keep margins below target. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))

Working capital volatility (especially around deferred revenue and other current items) may cause forecast cash flow deviations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1601046/000160104625000127/keys-20251031.htm))
